title: Techno's Potato War 16x
description: Texture Pack for minecraft inspired by the Great Potato War series and Technoblade's iconic Tightfault Texture Pack!
body: Texture Pack for minecraft inspired by the Great Potato War series and Technoblade's iconic Tightfault Texture Pack! Also includes imasquidkid squid and babysquid. We plan to add axes and armor updates next! Enjoy!
